name: Calendar Guides
description: How the calendar itself works, explained with dates you can check: which years share the same calendar and when a calendar repeats, leap years and the Gregorian century rule, ISO week numbers, Julian day-of-year numbers and the weekday a date falls on. Every rule is cited to the U.S. Naval Observatory, the International Organization for Standardization or another official source, and every date list is computed rather than copied. Stories come with a printable reference sheet and link to the yearly and monthly printable calendars, so readers can put an old calendar back to use or plan next year by week or day number.
